experiments.change: For an already-reviewed intent contract, carry its intent verdict into the evidence checkpoint when scope, authority, assumptions and acceptance criteria are unchanged. Review the new diff with a fresh artifact reviewer. Reopen the intent lane when any bound input changes. Keep user- or repository-required reviews.
experiments.prediction: Fewer repeated intent lanes and fewer total tokens. Require measured reductions in proposal cost and checkout-to-proposal time. Check total effort because the root also accounts for substantial spend.
experiments.falsifier: Reject if any unchanged-scope case loses a previously verified behavior or required independent check, or if the eligible tuning pairs do not improve on both cost and wall time.

experiments.change: When changing a public representation or behavior shared across contexts, choose one adjacent consumer or input boundary from the owning code. Execute a minimal example on the proposed patch, compare it with the starting behavior or explicit contract, and keep the regression test if it distinguishes the implementations.
experiments.prediction: Preserve tuple unpacking, UTF-8 byte positions and literal parameter-entity handling on the studied cases. Preserve the Black grammar fix. Improve matched code scores without losing readiness.
experiments.falsifier: Reject if the three executable counterexamples persist or a previously passing preservation gate regresses. Treat improved scores on exposed tasks as regression evidence.

measurement_repairs.scope: Version the evaluator independently of any plugin change.
measurement_repairs.evidence: Only a Markdown soft wrap separated pure Codex from a passing contract gate. The candidate checker in the observation rejects base and accepts both proposals and the merge.
measurement_repairs.sensitivity: If the control becomes ready and the original judge votes are held fixed, all three prefer Develop with a median 8.75 proposal-point advantage. A changed judge packet would need fresh assessment.
measurement_repairs.comparison: Do not compare the changed grader with the original grader as a treatment effect.

promotion.primary_comparator: plugin-free Codex on the same fresh tasks; use the prior Develop version to assess the effect of the change
promotion.scope: Preregister one change, a seed set, task selection, hard gates, cost policy and thresholds before releasing either arm. The published confirmation split is exposed.
required_metrics: paired code delta out of 85 and proposal delta out of 100
total tokens and cost with complete metering
joint quality, cost and speed wins
unknown or interrupted slots and assessor budget
promotion.strict_operating_target: For a panel-wide efficiency claim require no critical regressions, quality at least as good, and both cost and time ratios below 1 against the comparator. For a per-case claim require these conditions on every eligible pair and disclose exclusions. Use fresh unexposed tasks, report paired intervals, and repeat seeds when uncertainty crosses the threshold.
promotion.upstream: Compare proposal quality to each pinned merge. Original author labor, model usage and cost are unobserved.
